name: Launch Hub
description: Release time by timezone, editions and prices, and everything we know about Leonida, Jason and Lucia before and around launch.
intro: Everything around the 19 Nov 2026 launch: unlock times by time zone, pre-load size, editions and prices, platform facts and a launch-night checklist. Every page names its sources.

name: Mission Walkthroughs
description: Step-by-step GTA VI mission walkthroughs: objectives, gold-medal tips and what to do when you get stuck.
intro: Mission walkthroughs arrive once the missions are playable. Each will show its spoiler level first, keep story details in click-to-reveal boxes and say which version it was checked on.

name: Money Methods
description: The fastest ways to make money in GTA VI: heists, side hustles and repeatable earners, with how much they really pay.
intro: Money guides follow launch. We only publish methods that are tested or confirmed by a source, with payout figures, the platform and the date we checked.

name: Collectibles & Maps
description: Collectible locations and map guides for Leonida, with checklists and credited finds.
intro: Collectible and map guides follow launch: locations with credited sources, checklists and links to official maps. Anything unconfirmed is labelled as a rumour.

name: Best Cars
description: The best cars and bikes in GTA VI and exactly how to get them: locations, prices and handling notes.
intro: Car and bike guides will say where to find each vehicle, what it costs and how it handles, once players can verify it. Rumoured vehicles are always labelled.

name: Glitch Fixes
description: Known GTA VI bugs and glitches, with fixes and workarounds that actually work.
intro: Fixes for GTA VI problems on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S: download and pre-load trouble, launch errors and known bugs, with the steps in order and a source for each.

name: Beginner Tips
description: New to GTA VI? Start here: the beginner tips we wish we knew on day one.
intro: Short, sourced tips for your first hours: storage, what to expect from performance and what to check before you start. The spoiler level is shown on every page.

name: PS5 Settings
description: The best PS5 display, performance, audio and controller settings for GTA VI.
intro: What is known about GTA VI on PS5 and PS5 Pro, from official sources, with the settings steps for your console.

name: Leaks & Rumors
description: Unconfirmed GTA VI leaks and rumours, clearly labelled, sourced and kept separate from verified guides.
intro: Unconfirmed GTA VI leaks and rumours, kept apart from verified guides. Every page carries a rumour warning, names where it came from and hides spoiler details in click-to-reveal boxes.
